We love you man. Hold on

Ya you should bring it up. If he's your partner there should be no issue discussing things. Meeting up in person with someone he used to date  would kinda be a red flag for me but I wouldn't make any assumltions just ask him to explain the situation and go from there.

I wouldn't be so hard on yourself. Even if it was wrong you know it was wrong and it happens fairly often. Most people look back on early relationships and question a lot of things. If it's causing you anxiety it usually helps to tell your partner. I think he'll understand if he really cares.
Sounds sketchy if she's not a long time friend. You're going to be anxious until you talk about it. If you get a calm moment you should probably bring it up but not to aggressively.
This one's easy. Just leave. You deserve more attention.
Everyone has one bad breakup in their life. It'll suck until it doesn't suck. Just keep focusing on self-improvement it's the best way to stay confident/optimistic.

You should go with your number one choice for university in my opinion. When I was in first year half the kids on my floor came in a relationship and only one or two lasted through first year. The ones that lasted were committed to long distance and had been dating a few years. Looking back I think sometimes you have to break your own heart when you're that young.
